Data model: One table in one file (CSV); or a complete DBMS inside the program, the database in one file
Typical question: Exchange one table; analyse it on one computer
Open-source products of this course: CSV files · SQLite (public domain) · DuckDB (MIT licence)

Data model: Tables of rows and columns, linked by primary and foreign keys; constraints; transactions
Typical question: Many users change related data that must stay correct

Data model: Documents (JSON) · key-value pairs · wide columns · graphs of nodes and relationships
Typical question: The whole record · the value for a key · very many writes · paths through relationships
Open-source products of this course: Apache CouchDB, FerretDB · Valkey · Apache Cassandra · Neo4j Community, Apache AGE

Data model: Columnar files; one job split over many machines
Typical question: Summaries over more data than one machine handles
Open-source products of this course: Apache Parquet · Apache Spark · DuckDB on one laptop

Data model: A ledger of blocks, each storing the hash of the previous one; many independent copies
Typical question: A shared record that no single organisation can alter
Open-source products of this course: Bitcoin Core, Ethereum (public) · Hyperledger Fabric (known participants)
